Below is a process-mining-style event log derived from the Windows activity system log. I grouped events into coherent cases based on the document/email being worked on and the user’s context switches between applications.

## Process Mining Event Log

| Case ID | Event ID | Timestamp (UTC) | Activity Name | Application | Object / Window | Additional Info |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | 1 | 2024-12-11T08:59:50.000Z | Open Quarterly Report Draft | Microsoft Word | Quarterly_Report.docx | FOCUS |
| C2 | 1 | 2024-12-11T09:00:00.000Z | Open Working Document | Microsoft Word | Document1.docx | FOCUS |
| C2 | 2 | 2024-12-11T09:00:30.000Z | Draft Document Content | Microsoft Word | Document1.docx | Draft intro paragraph |
| C2 | 3 | 2024-12-11T09:01:00.000Z | Continue Drafting | Microsoft Word | Document1.docx | Additional details here |
| C2 | 4 | 2024-12-11T09:01:15.000Z | Save Document | Microsoft Word | Document1.docx | SAVE |
| C3 | 1 | 2024-12-11T09:01:45.000Z | Switch to Email Inbox | Google Chrome | Email - Inbox | From Word Document1.docx |
| C3 | 2 | 2024-12-11T09:02:00.000Z | Open Email About Annual Meeting | Google Chrome | Email - Inbox | Open Email about Annual Meeting |
| C3 | 3 | 2024-12-11T09:02:30.000Z | Review Email Thread | Google Chrome | Email - Inbox | SCROLL Down |
| C3 | 4 | 2024-12-11T09:02:45.000Z | Prepare Reply | Google Chrome | Email - Inbox | Reply to Email |
| C3 | 5 | 2024-12-11T09:03:00.000Z | Compose Reply | Google Chrome | Email - Inbox | Meeting details confirmed |
| C3 | 6 | 2024-12-11T09:03:20.000Z | Send Email | Google Chrome | Email - Inbox | Send Email |
| C4 | 1 | 2024-12-11T09:04:00.000Z | Switch to PDF Review | Adobe Acrobat | Report_Draft.pdf | From Chrome Email - Inbox |
| C4 | 2 | 2024-12-11T09:04:30.000Z | Review PDF Document | Adobe Acrobat | Report_Draft.pdf | SCROLL Down |
| C4 | 3 | 2024-12-11T09:04:45.000Z | Highlight Key Findings | Adobe Acrobat | Report_Draft.pdf | Key Findings |
| C5 | 1 | 2024-12-11T09:05:00.000Z | Open Budget Spreadsheet | Microsoft Excel | Budget_2024.xlsx | FOCUS |
| C5 | 2 | 2024-12-11T09:05:15.000Z | Update Budget Figures | Microsoft Excel | Budget_2024.xlsx | Update Q1 figures |
| C5 | 3 | 2024-12-11T09:05:30.000Z | Insert Budget Row | Microsoft Excel | Budget_2024.xlsx | Insert new row for Q2 |
| C5 | 4 | 2024-12-11T09:05:45.000Z | Save Spreadsheet | Microsoft Excel | Budget_2024.xlsx | SAVE |
| C2 | 5 | 2024-12-11T09:06:00.000Z | Switch Back to Document | Microsoft Word | Document1.docx | From Excel Budget_2024.xlsx |
| C2 | 6 | 2024-12-11T09:06:15.000Z | Insert Budget Reference | Microsoft Word | Document1.docx | Inserting reference to budget |
| C2 | 7 | 2024-12-11T09:06:30.000Z | Save Document | Microsoft Word | Document1.docx | SAVE |
| C2 | 8 | 2024-12-11T09:07:00.000Z | Close Document | Microsoft Word | Document1.docx | CLOSE |
| C1 | 2 | 2024-12-11T09:07:15.000Z | Continue Quarterly Report Editing | Microsoft Word | Quarterly_Report.docx | FOCUS |
| C1 | 3 | 2024-12-11T09:07:45.000Z | Draft Executive Summary | Microsoft Word | Quarterly_Report.docx | Executive Summary draft |
| C1 | 4 | 2024-12-11T09:08:00.000Z | Save Quarterly Report | Microsoft Word | Quarterly_Report.docx | SAVE |
| C1 | 5 | 2024-12-11T09:08:15.000Z | Close Quarterly Report | Microsoft Word | Quarterly_Report.docx | CLOSE |

---

## Brief Explanation of Case Grouping Logic

I created cases based on the **work object being handled**:

- **C1**: Quarterly_Report.docx  
  A distinct Word document that is opened, edited, saved, and closed near the end. The early focus event and later return to the same file suggest one coherent document-centric case.

- **C2**: Document1.docx  
  This is the main Word drafting case. It includes writing text, saving, switching away, later returning to insert a budget reference, and finally closing the document. I kept all these related actions in one case because they represent a single continuous document-editing task.

- **C3**: Email reply in Gmail/Chrome  
  The user opens an email about an annual meeting, reviews it, drafts a reply, and sends it. This is a clear email-handling case.

- **C4**: PDF review in Adobe Acrobat  
  The user reviews a report draft PDF, scrolls through it, and highlights key findings. This is a separate reading/review task.

- **C5**: Budget spreadsheet in Excel  
  The user updates budget figures, inserts a new row, and saves the spreadsheet. This is a self-contained spreadsheet editing case.

### Activity Naming Logic
I translated low-level actions into higher-level, process-friendly activity names:
- **FOCUS / SWITCH** → opening or switching to a work object/application
- **TYPING** → drafting, updating, composing, or inserting content depending on context
- **CLICK on reply/send/open** → preparing reply, opening email, sending email
- **SCROLL / HIGHLIGHT** → reviewing a document
- **SAVE / CLOSE** → standard document lifecycle actions

This yields an event log that is suitable for standard process mining tools and more interpretable for analysis than raw system events.
